summary: Moolec Science SA filed a Form 6-K announcing it regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum stockholders' equity requirement after a Panel extension. The company reported equity of approximately $15.2 million as of March 31, 2026 and $11.3 million as of December 31, 2025, as shown in its unaudited financials. The filing also notes a partial conversion of preference shares worth $5.47 million and a related-party line of credit disbursement. There are no acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation terms; this is a routine listing compliance update. No deal terms apply.
